req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json content type for all echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) return application/json content type. Tests cover: (1) positive EP for each method returning exact 'application/json' content-type, (2) negative path for wrong HTTP method returning 405 (not 2xx, not JSON), (3) boundary check that the content-type header value starts with exactly 'application/json' and not a superset/subset string, (4) decision table covering all five endpoints, (5) exact status code 200 assertions to catch status-code mutations. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 vs 201 vs 2xx), exact content-type strings, and exact JSON structure keys.

tests.name: test_get_returns_application_json_content_type
actions: Send GET request to /get via test client
Inspect response status and Content-Type header
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got {ct}'
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'origin' in data

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html
actions: Send GET to /get
Assert Content-Type is exactly 'application/json' prefix, not 'text/html' or 'text/plain'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 — exact content-type boundary; catches mutation of 'application/json' string constant
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Got: {ct}'
    assert not ct.startswith('text/html'), f'Should not be text/html, got: {ct}'
    assert not ct.startswith('text/plain'), f'Should not be text/plain, got: {ct}'
    assert not ct.startswith('application/xml'), f'Should not be application/xml, got: {ct}'
    assert 'application/json' in ct

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_return_200_and_json_decision_table
actions: Send correct HTTP method to each of /get /post /put /patch /delete
Assert each returns 200 and application/json
expected: All five endpoints return Content-Type: application/json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 — decision table covering all five endpoints and their correct methods
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_return_200_and_json_decision_table():
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in cases:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} => {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'{method} {path} CT={ct}'
        body = r.get_json()
        assert body is not None, f'{method} {path} body not JSON'
        assert isinstance(body, dict), f'{method} {path} body not dict'

tests.name: test_get_response_json_body_has_required_keys
actions: Send GET /get with a query param
Assert response JSON contains url, args, headers, origin keys with correct values
expected: JSON body contains 'args' with the sent query param
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_response_json_body_has_required_keys():
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}
    assert 'json' not in data
    assert 'form' not in data

tests.name: test_post_json_body_echoed_in_response
actions: Send POST /post with JSON body
Assert response JSON contains 'json' key with the sent payload
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_json_body_echoed_in_response():
    payload = {'key': 'value', 'num': 42}
    r = client.post(
        '/post',
        data=json.dumps(payload),
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert data['json'] == {'key': 'value', 'num': 42}
    assert data['json']['num'] == 42
    assert data['json']['key'] == 'value'

tests.name: test_content_type_charset_boundary
actions: Send GET /get
Check Content-Type header for exact 'application/json' prefix and optional charset
expected: If charset present it is utf-8
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 — boundary on content-type string value; catches constant-string mutation
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_charset_boundary():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 204
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'CT={ct}'
    parts = [p.strip() for p in ct.split(';')]
    assert parts[0] == 'application/json', f'First part should be application/json, got {parts[0]}'
    if len(parts) > 1:
        charset_part = parts[1].lower()
        assert 'charset' in charset_part
        assert 'utf-8' in charset_part, f'Expected utf-8 charset, got {charset_part}'
